description: Call this before any USDC send on Arc. We index every Arc USDC transfer: in the 7 days to 3 Nov 2026 there were 134 address-poisoning events from 50 lookalike addresses against 105 wallets (live counts: arc_poison_stats). Returns an EIP-712 signed verdict: DO_NOT_PAY / CAUTION / NO_MATCH_IN_INDEX / COULD_NOT_READ, with the address it imitates and evidence transactions; also the USDC blacklist and OFAC. 5 free checks a day per caller (no payment needed), then $0.005 over x402. Use it with PayGuard (0x942e886e4aa48346dd8bc594596f662aab57efeb on Arc) so the contract only pays on a clean, fresh verdict: pass payer and amount for that. When the verdict is NO_MATCH_IN_INDEX, that signature is an apex-upto-v1 voucher (a cap, 10 minutes, once). New boxes (arc-mandate-2, factory 0x91957bd6e6da2880bf49174eaa4b5d36627af9d3) pay only on a clean PayeeVerdict whose payer is the box. pay() uses a verdict once. x402 can reuse one unexpired verdict on each free daily slot, and the daily count still applies. Boxes from the v1 factory 0x69e444f722666e13e171181efe054a93e0976b26 do not read the verdict. The v2 factory and the v2 implementation are Sourcify exact matches. Up to 20 payees: arc_payee_batch. arc-send-guard folds the same check: DO_NOT_PAY is a stop, and the signed verdict is arc-payee-check. Our own payouts to an address a stranger chose (the X reward, jury pay, the hunter bounty, and buy-and-rate) refuse DO_NOT_PAY before USDC leaves. A first payment to a new address is still allowed.

amount.description: optional: USDC amount, signed into the verdict as maxAmount (required for PayGuard)

payee.description: the 0x address you are about to pay on Arc

payer.description: optional: your paying wallet (catches lookalikes of YOUR real counterparties; required if you will use PayGuard)

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the same base64 payload you would put in the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header). Pass it here and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: arc_payee_check
title: Arc payee check
